R4F-bear-drive-0004.name: 140 m NE of Soards Creek
R4F-bear-drive-0004.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2014 (12 years old), 270 m NE: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2023 (fire N40596), 460 m N: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
SW facing slope, 21 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Soards Creek 140 m SW: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: bag 2; private land only, with landowner permission

plan: Drive: from Mica Creek, about 12 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 23, 1000 (Soards)/.310.
Park: 52.02779, -118.70228, pull off on 1000 (Soards)/.310 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: none. The spot is at the road.

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-39, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-10, closures 2026-10-16.
R4F-bear-drive-0004.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-39: about 130 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.05 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.0 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
